title: Latvian Foreign Ministry proposes national 'blood grain' transit ban
summary_full: The Latvian Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on November 13th that, in cooperation with other competent ministries, it has prepared a draft Cabinet regulation proposing a ban on the transit of grain originating in Russia and Belarus through the territory of Latvia.
